NEWS: Tesla is rolling out a new web-based Dashcam Viewer with software update 2026.20.

Owners will be able to view Dashcam clips directly at dashcam.tesla.com without needing to access the footage through the vehicle.

The new viewer also makes it easier to review, organize and download footage while preserving important driving data tied to each recording.

Another example of Tesla turning the car into a connected platform that keeps getting better through software updates.

In case you were wondering the aerodynamics of Elon Musk 💨

Imagine a company that builds EVs, rockets, satellites, AI models, humanoid robots and eventually infrastructure for Mars.

That's the vision some investors see behind a potential Tesla–SpaceX merger.

Combined, the two companies could be worth around $3.4 trillion based on recent valuations, creating one of the largest technology companies in history.

Supporters argue it would unite Tesla's manufacturing and AI expertise with SpaceX's launch capabilities, Starlink network and future space ambitions.

Whether it happens or not, the fact that people are seriously discussing a company of this scale shows how far Elon Musk's ecosystem has grown.

Tesla vehicle registrations in Germany surged 322% in May compared to the same time last year. Data released by the Federal Motor Transport Authority shows Tesla registered 5,111 vehicles during the month, claiming an 8.5% share of the country's battery electric vehicle market.

The year-to-date numbers are even more impressive. Tesla has registered 21,089 vehicles in Germany so far this year, which is a 200% increase over the 7,030 units registered during the exact same period last year.

This current year-to-date sales volume already beats Tesla's entire total for the full year of 2025 by about 9%. The momentum shows a massive turnaround in Europe's largest automotive market, where total electric vehicle adoption hit a 25% penetration rate last month.
